title: Gaza Health Ministry reports preceding-day hospital casualty arrivals
summary_or_snippet: In its November 9 bulletin, Gaza's Health Ministry reported three deaths and 15 injury cases received by hospitals during the preceding 24 hours. It classified two deaths as new and one as resulting from earlier wounds. The underlying attack dates and victim status were not established. These are attributed hospital figures, not an independently verified total of events on November 9.
